# Unit test for function prime_fib
def test_prime_fib():
    # Test known prime Fibonacci numbers
    assert prime_fib(1) == 2, "1st prime Fibonacci should be 2"
    assert prime_fib(2) == 3, "2nd prime Fibonacci should be 3"
    assert prime_fib(3) == 5, "3rd prime Fibonacci should be 5"
    assert prime_fib(4) == 13, "4th prime Fibonacci should be 13"
    assert prime_fib(5) == 89, "5th prime Fibonacci should be 89"
    assert prime_fib(6) == 233, "6th prime Fibonacci should be 233"
    assert prime_fib(7) == 1597, "7th prime Fibonacci should be 1597"
    assert prime_fib(8) == 28657, "8th prime Fibonacci should be 28657"
    assert prime_fib(9) == 514229, "9th prime Fibonacci should be 514229"
    assert prime_fib(10) == 433494437, "10th prime Fibonacci should be 433494437"

    # Verify results are strictly increasing
    prev = 0
    for i in range(1, 8):
        val = prime_fib(i)
        assert val > prev, f"prime_fib({i}) should exceed previous prime"
        prev = val

    # Verify each returned value is prime

            return False
        for k in range(2, int(math.sqrt(p)) + 1):
            if p % k == 0:

        return True

    for i in range(1, 11):
        assert is_prime_check(prime_fib(i)), f"prime_fib({i}) is not prime"

    print("All tests passed!")
